svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Shutter cluster · shoot running · landscape
svg.desc: Any shoot under way (isCapturing: interval, live blend, photo burst — video has its own state): the disc becomes the stop square and the four framing toggles hide. The top pair now holds the RUN-TIME toggles (design 2026-09-04, third pass): slot 1 screen DIM (moon — amber while dimming is engaged: the screen floors at once, a touch wakes it for 30 s and it re-dims unless the toggle is turned off; Settings' Dim-during-shoot seeds it), slot 2 INFO (info.circle — off by default; on, the one diagnostics panel joins the readout). The bottom pair stays empty. Interval runs and Photo bursts show exactly this.
